title: UI World
summary: A chat-app UI fills the top of the frame: clips drop in, a command types itself, and the speaker pokes out over it.
description: The top of the frame becomes a cream chat app (starburst logo + app name, a dashed 'Drop files here' zone). Video clips fly in on arcs and drop into the zone, which turns into a message composer; a yellow tape label sticks on, then a slash command types itself out and the send button lights up and gets pressed. The footage slides down into the bottom panel and the speaker is cut out so their head breaks out over the app background. Captions sit on the speaker in bold caps.

options.clips: how many clip thumbnails fly in (1-6)
options.thumbs: optional list of image/video files for the thumbnails (default: frames from your clip)
options.label: text on the yellow tape label ("" to hide)
options.command: what gets typed into the composer (e.g. /video-editor)
options.typeSpeed: typing speed in characters per second
options.inAt: when the UI slides in (seconds or "@word")
options.intro: "slide" (app drops in from the top) or "cut" (appears instantly)
options.dropAt: "auto" (on drop/upload/clip/file/video) or when the clips start flying in
options.labelAt: "auto" (right after the clips land) or when the tape label sticks on
options.typeAt: "auto" (on trigger/run/skill/command..., else halfway) or when typing starts
options.sendAt: "auto" (just after typing ends) or when the send button is pressed
options.outAt: optional: when the app slides away and the footage returns to full frame (null = stays)
options.split: where the app background ends and the video panel starts, 0-1 of the height
options.shift: "auto" (move the footage so the head sits under the composer) or a 0-1 fraction of the height to move it down
